==Description==
'''M-22''' is the first hostile entity you will encounter within the [[Section M]], serving as a replacement for [[E-30|M-30]]. It behaves differently from the latter, as you will see throughout this page. More information on '''M-22''' will be provided below.

==Mechanic==
When '''M-22''' spawns, it will make a weird sound. '''M-22''' will then rush to the current room and rebounding back, eventually despawning. Any player seen by M-22 will start taking damage rapidly, while not being fully hidden will also result with rapid damage.

==Strategy & Tips==
*Once '''M-22''' passes you while it's heading back to its spawning point, you can exit your hiding spot, as it will no longer be a threat.
** However, in certain situations, you may have to avoid [[Claustrophobia]] to counter another entity.
*In certain situations, more likely in Red Rooms, you may have to quick-enter a locker to avoid damage from '''M-22'''.
**Although this can come in handy if you're in a pinch, you will have to beware of M-134's presence in your designated hiding spot, if it's a locker.

==Trivia==
* '''M-22''' is the 2nd yellow entity in the game that you can currently encounter naturally, with [[D-60i]] ''(Invader is mostly declared yellow principally in phase 2).''
* '''M-22''' can be shot, and enough hits will result in it instantly retreating back, it cannot damage the player in this state.
* '''M-22''' doesn't care about tables, and will still damage players hiding under them.
* For a time, '''M-22''' was completely silent due to the old audio getting moderated.
** This was fixed with new audio a couple of hours later
